notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.48
notes.notes:
Fixed a rare issue where the lift in chapter 4 near the 4-key-door could get stuck when the player steps on it to go up.
 Fixed a rare issue where you could be detected in Chapter 3 when hiding under the table.
 Fixed an issue where you could be detected when hiding behind a box in Chapter 9

notes.title: Out of Sight update: Guiding indicator option and demo fix!
notes.notes:
We have been making some updates for Out of Sight!

We heard your wishes and have added an option to turn off the guiding indicators (in the form of yellow tape and other visual indicators that point the way forward) along with some other fixes. This makes it possible for all you players to explore the game unguided if you wish!

We have also updated our demo with some visual fixes to make it even more enjoyable to try! Last but not least, we fixed the missing translations in the settings menu and the auto-save popup.



Celebrate Out of Sight´s one-month anniversary with us by joining Sophie and Teddy on their adventure!

notes.title: Patch notes 1.0.44
notes.notes:
Slower systems that cannot stream in new areas of the game fast enough will now pause to finish loading the area before allowing you to enter. This fixes an issue where key elements like locked doors or switches could be missing until they finished loading. Or you falling through missing floor.
 Fixed a rare issue where Clayton could get stuck in the Chapter 3 workshop room due to the door closing before he was able to exit.
 Fixed an issue in Chapter 7 pipe-ceiling-room where you could get stuck if you moved up the pipes without Teddy.
 Fixed an issue where Teddy was very difficult to pick back up in some locations (notably on movable boxes).
 Fixed an issue with the "YoYo" collectible where you could pick up both the collectible and Teddy at the same time, making you stuck.
 Made inverted horizontal/vertical look work on mouse as well (previously only worked on controller)
 Other minor fixes.

notes.title: Hotfix May 24th
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue caused by the previous hotfix where Lost & Found collectibles would not grant achievements.
[olist]
Any collectibles affected by this bug will now automatically grant their respective achievement when opening the Lost & Found page on a save where they have been collected.
[/olist]
 Fixed an issue caused by the previous hotfix where the "Lucille's Blanket" collectible did not show up in the Lost & Found list after being collected.

notes.title: Hotfix May 23rd
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue with the end room of the Banquet hall in Chapter 7 where restarting from a checkpoint could cause a movable box to get permanently stuck
 Fixed a crash that could occur if opening the collectibles menu immediately after starting to pick up a new collectible

notes.title: Release date!
notes.notes:
Out of Sight will release on the 22nd of May!
Join Sophie and Teddy on their adventure and unravel the mysteries of Out of Sight!!
